newsitem.title: USA: Zycad sees Q3 oper loss, to cut workforce.
newsitem.headline: Zycad sees Q3 oper loss, to cut workforce.

text.p: Zycad Corp said Monday it expects a significant operating loss for the third quarter, and plans to cut its workforce by about 30 percent.
It said it expects revenues for the third quarter to be in the range of $6.0 million to 7.0 million, "well short of expectations", due to deferral of purchases by U.S. customers.
Zycad said it expects the workforce cuts and other cost reduction actions to reduce quarterly operating costs by some $4 million.
"The primary reason for the revenue shortfall was deferral of Accelerator purchases by the company's traditionally strong U.S. customer base," said Zycad President Phillips Smith.

"These U.S. purchase delays were caused by a combination of customer project delays and quarterly capital budget constraints. Numerous semi-conductor companies have had capital expenditures on hold throughout the quarter and while we are seeing more encouraging news within the past two weeks, it has been too late to impact their third quarter capital expenditures," he added.
Smith said he believes the market situation is transitory but it could continue to affect results for the next few quarters.
Shares of Zycad closed 1/16 higher at 4-1/16 on Nasdaq.
